units.memory: MiB except alloc fields, which are bytes

method.environment: private fixture, hidden nested Hyprland; inherited FART_* unset
method.driver_note: One DRM client sampled; repeated fdinfo entries were not summed. Driver allocations are separate from RSS/PSS.
method.probe_note: Temporary IPC for GC and controls; native QObject/allocator probes. baseline has glibc-only allocator probe; jemalloc statistics are available in subsequent runs.
method.stimulus_note: pointer/default_alloc use hover and click cycles; baseline/cpu/ablations use IPC. verify_* use all 56 simulated bins with nondegenerate amplitudes.
method.scope_note: CAVA producer CPU and current-HEAD integration were not measured. Ablations overlap; allocator tuning combines three settings and does not isolate each setting.
